import numpy as np


def to_long_index(idx, shape):

    ndims = len(shape)
    long_idx = 0
    siz = 1
    for axis in range(ndims):
        idx_ = idx[ndims - 1 - axis]
        long_idx += idx_ * siz
        siz *= shape[ndims - 1 - axis]

    return long_idx


def to_index_tuple(long_idx, shape):
    ndims = len(shape)
    idx = np.zeros(ndims, dtype=int)
    for k in range(ndims):
        s = np.prod(shape[k + 1 :])
        idx[k] = long_idx // s
        long_idx = long_idx - s * idx[k]

    return tuple(idx)
